site.ogDescription: Tuʻatiraʻa peer-to-peer o te mau faila i niʻa i te ʻihi rurutia āpī vahi-tuati. ʻAore tahua afaro. ʻAore vahi tahi noa o te ofatiraʻa.

hero.subtitle: ʻUi āpī o te tuʻatiraʻa peer-to-peer o te mau faila
hero.description: I niʻa i te ʻihi rurutia āpī vahi-tuati. ʻAore tahua afaro. ʻAore vahi tahi noa o te ofatiraʻa.

about.title: No
about.intro: Te {project} e tahua o te ʻui āpī no te tuʻatiraʻa peer-to-peer o te mau faila i hāmanihia i niʻa i te ʻihi rurutia āpī vahi-tuati. Te tāpaʻo nei ʻo ia i te hōhoʻa-ʻāmui mea māmā e te hāmaniraʻa vahi-tuati taʻatoʻa, te āratai mai nei i te tuʻatiraʻa parau o te paruru e o te tiʻaturi mā te hinaʻaro ʻore i te hoʻē mana afaro. ʻO teie ʻōhipa e open source, ʻafaʻihia i raro aʻe i te {license}.

decentralized.title: Faanahoraʻa vahi-tuati taʻatoʻa
decentralized.description: ʻAore tahua afaro, ʻaore vahi tahi noa o te ofatiraʻa. Te ʻite e te hopoʻi nei te mau ʻāmui i te mau parau ʻāmui mai te tahi i te tahi, mā te tiʻaturi ʻore i te hoʻē tāpura, tarekā, aore ra fare parau afaro.

accessControl.title: Faatereraʻa o te ōraʻa hōhonu
accessControl.description: Pou e taʻata e nehenehe e haʻamata i tāna iho faanahoraʻa mā te ʻore o te moni mā tāna iho mau ture. I roto i te tahi e tahi faanahoraʻa, parau i te tareʻa o te mau ʻāmui: ʻai fenua, faaterehau, taʻata neneʻi, taʻata haʻavāra e taʻata hopoʻi. Faatere hōhonu i te taʻata o te nehenehe e neneʻi, haʻavāra, e hopoʻi i te mau parau ʻāmui.

ui.title: Hōhoʻa-ʻāmui o te toʻo teitei
ui.description: Hōhoʻa-ʻāmui no te tāhua peʻe māmā e te tāmaroʻiroʻi, hāmanihia no te ʻāfata roa, te TV e te mau tahua poromū. Te haereraʻa māmā nā roto i te papa-mau, te ʻiore, te tāʻiri-haʻutiraʻa aore ra te mau māʻū. Te mau ʻāmui matau e nehenehe e haʻa i te poroterama mai te tahua faila tei haʻamoeʻiri ʻore nā roto i te hōhoʻa-ʻāmui o te ʻāʻano faatureraʻa.

dataFormat.title: Faanahoraʻa o te mau parau e tāʻio-pātia-ʻia e te taʻata
dataFormat.description: Te faanahoraʻa o te mau parau LISH e hāmanihia i niʻa i te JSON, te haʻafāʻito nei i te poiete, i te tāʻio e i te taʻa. Tūʻa i tā ʻoe parau ʻāmui ma te metadata māmā e te ʻite-ʻiahia o te taʻata atoʻa e nehenehe e tirotiro mā te māmā.

security.title: Mau pārakapuʻa e te paruru
security.description: Te mau parau peer-to-peer ʻātoʻa e nāmuhia, e tāmau nei e te vai pārakapuʻa nō tā ʻoe mau parau i te taime o te tuʻutiraʻa. Te mau ʻāmui e nehenehe e ʻurupu i muri i te VPN no te tahi paeau hau o te ʻiteʻa-ʻorehia. Te {project} te faatura nei i tā ʻoe pārakapuʻa nā roto i te hāmaniraʻa.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Te poroterama e vai nei i niʻa i te Windows, Linux e te macOS. Faaohipa i niʻa i te mauiha o tā ʻoe e hinaʻaro nei.

download.title: Hopoʻi mai
download.description: Noaʻa i te {project} no tā ʻoe tahua. Te mau hopoʻiraʻa ʻātoʻa e ʻāveʻave e e open source.

items.viewOnGithub: Hiʻopoʻa i niʻa i te GitHub

macos.title: Parau faufaʻa nō te mau ʻāmui o te macOS:
macos.intro: Te faatāpea nei te macOS Gatekeeper i te mau āpi tei ʻore i tāpaʻopaʻo/notarihia i hopoʻihia mai te ārapū, ma te tarahaparaʻa {error}.
macos.error: "ʻua ʻino, ʻaore e nehenehe e ʻīriti"
macos.runCommand: I muri aʻe i tā ʻoe hopoʻiraʻa i te DMG aore ra ZIP, hou aʻe ʻoe i te ʻīritiraʻa i te āpi, faaʻohipa teie faataeraʻa i roto i te Terminal:
macos.exampleDmg: Hiʻoraʻa, i muri aʻe i te tāmauraʻa mai te DMG:

macos.explanation: Teie e faaʻore mai i te ʻano koeʻe e e haʻafaufaʻa i te āpi e ʻohipa.
